judge.rationale: The candidate appear to have stopped after the red phase of TDD: it wrote a definition of done (`.lore/dod.md`) and a failing acceptance test (`chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`), but never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the implementation is missing, the newly added test will fail and the bug remains unfixed. Furthermore, the candidate failed to remove the recorded-flaw line in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, failed to document what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn ran, and omitted the `CHANGELOG.md` entry required by the acceptance criteria.
